101: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
One who obtains the essence of the Name becomes immortal (spiritual death cannot touch him).
ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ. ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
The treasure of the Name is obtained by one in whose mind the Guru's Word dwells. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
One who has obtained the Lord's essence is satisfied and fulfilled.
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਡੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
One who has tasted the Lord's flavour does not waver.
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
He alone obtains the Lord's Name on whose forehead good fortune is written. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ. ਇਕਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਆਇਆ; ਵਰਸਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
The Lord has come into the hands of the One (the Guru), and many are blessed through him.
Clinging to him, countless are liberated.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਵਿਰਲੀ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
The treasure of the Name is found through the Guru; says Nanak, rare are those who have seen it. ॥4॥15॥22॥
ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
The Lord is my nine treasures, my spiritual powers and my wealth.
By the grace of the deep and profound Lord, this human life is a priceless gift.
ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ; ਜੋ. ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
One who falls at the Guru's feet enjoys hundreds of thousands, millions of joys. ॥1॥
Beholding the Guru's sight, I have been purified,
and all my brothers and friends have been saved.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
By the Guru's grace I meditate on my inaccessible, imperceptible, True Master. ॥2॥
He whom all His creatures seek —
rare is the fortunate one who obtains His sight.
ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਥਾਨਾ; ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ. ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
His place is lofty, infinite and imperceptible; the Guru shows that mansion. ॥3॥
O deep and profound Lord, Your Name is life-giving nectar.
One in whose heart it dwells is liberated.
ਗੁਰਿ. ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੇ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
The Guru has cut away all their bonds; O servant Nanak, they merge in poise. ॥4॥16॥23॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
By God's grace I meditate on the Lord.
By God's kindness I sing songs of joy.
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ. ਸਗਲ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Rising up, sitting down, sleeping and waking, meditate on the Lord all your life. ॥1॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ ॥
The Holy One (the Guru) has given me the medicine of the Name.
My sins are cut away and I have become pure.
ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ; ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Bliss has come, all pain has left me, and all my sorrows are gone. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ; ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
One whose side my Beloved takes
ਸਤਿ ਕਰੇ. ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ; ਸੋ. ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
One who with faith has recognised the Guru — why should he be afraid? ॥3॥
Since I found the company of the Holy,
meeting the Guru, the curse of ego is gone.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ. ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
With every breath Nanak sings of the Lord; the True Guru has covered my faults and kept my honour. ॥4॥17॥24॥
Through and through, like warp and weft, He is blended with His servant.
God, the Giver of peace, cherishes His servants.
ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
I carry water, wave the fan and grind the corn for His servants, whose only concern is the Master. ॥1॥
Cutting away the noose, God has attached me to His service.
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ; ਸੇਵਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
The Master's command is pleasing to the servant's mind.
ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ. ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
He does only what pleases the Master; the servant is wise within and without. ॥2॥
ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
You are the all-knowing Master; You know every way.
102: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ॥
The Master's servants enjoy the Lord's love.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ. ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ; ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Whatever belongs to the Master belongs to the servant; the servant becomes known through the Master. ॥3॥
One whom his Master has robed in honour
is not called again to give his account.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ. ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ; ਸੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰਾ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant; he is deep, profound and priceless as a pearl. ॥4॥18॥25॥
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Everything is within the home of the self; nothing is outside.
One who searches outside is lost in doubt.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Those who by the Guru's grace have found Him within are happy within and without. ॥1॥
Gently, gently, the stream of nectar rains down.
The mind drinks it in, hearing the Word and reflecting on it.
ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Day and night it enjoys bliss and delight, playing forever with the Lord. ॥2॥
Separated for countless births, one is united again.
By the Holy One's grace, the dried-up branch turns green again.
ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ, ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
One receives good understanding and meditates on the Name; through the Guru, union comes. ॥3॥
As a wave of water merges back into the water,
so the light merges into the Light.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਟੇ ਕਿਵਾੜਾ; ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ. ਜਉਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
Says Nanak, the shutters of doubt are cut away, and one does not wander running after Maya again. ॥4॥19॥26॥
I am a sacrifice to the one who has heard of You.
I am devoted to the one who utters You with his tongue.
ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ. ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Again and again I am a sacrifice to the one who worships You with mind and body. ॥1॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੀ; ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
I wash the feet of the one who walks on Your path.
With my eyes I long to behold that merciful Lord.
ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ. ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਜਨ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
I give my mind to that friend who, meeting the Guru, has found God. ॥2॥
Fortunate are those who have known You.
He dwells within all, yet remains detached and free of desire.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਉਨਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ; ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ. ਉਨਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
In the company of the holy they have crossed the terrifying world-ocean, and subdued all the demons (vices). ॥3॥
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਆ; ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
who have given up pride, power, and the darkness of attachment.
ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
Give Nanak the gift of the Name of that inaccessible, unfathomable Lord. ॥4॥20॥27॥
You are the tree; the world is Your branches in bloom.
You are subtle and unseen, and have become the visible world.
ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ. ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ; ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
You are the ocean, and You are the foam and the bubbles; besides You, nothing else is seen. ॥1॥
You are the thread, and You are also the beads.
You are the knot, and You are the chief bead at the head.
ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
In the beginning, middle and end, there is God alone; no other is seen. ॥2॥
You are beyond all qualities and within them; You are the Giver of peace.
You are free of desire, yet the Enjoyer, steeped in love.
ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਤਬ, ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
You alone know Your own ways, and You Yourself take care of all. ॥3॥
You are the Master, and the servant too.
O God, You Yourself are hidden and manifest.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ. ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੮॥
Slave Nanak sings Your praises forever; look upon me with Your glance of grace for just a moment. ॥4॥21॥28॥
103: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Fruitful is that Bani through which the Name is chanted.
By the Guru's grace, rare is the one who understands it.
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ. ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ; ਆਏ ਤੇ. ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Blessed is that time when the Lord's praises are sung and heard; the coming into the world of such people is approved. ॥1॥
ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ; ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
Approved are those eyes which have beheld His sight.
ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
Good are those hands which write the Lord's praises.
ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ. ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿ. ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Beautiful are those feet which walk on the Lord's path; I am a sacrifice to them, for in their company the Lord is recognised. ॥2॥
Listen, O my dear friend, my beloved companion:
in the company of the holy, one is saved in an instant.
ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Sins are cut away and the mind becomes pure; coming and going are ended. ॥3॥
ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ; ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
With palms pressed together, let this one prayer be offered:
in Your mercy, save this sinking stone (hard-hearted one).
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ॥4॥22॥29॥
Your Bani, O Lord, is life-giving nectar.
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Hearing it again and again, I attain the supreme state.
ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
The burning is quenched and the mind is cooled, obtaining the sight of the True Guru. ॥1॥
Peace has come and pain has run far away,
since the saint (Guru) has uttered the Lord's Name with his tongue.
ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ, ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
As rain fills the hollows, the dry land and the pools to the brim, so no one leaves the Guru's door empty. ॥2॥
The Creator has shown His mercy,
and cherishes all beings and creatures.
ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
The kind, compassionate, merciful Lord has satisfied and fulfilled all. ॥3॥
He has made the forests, the meadows and the three worlds green.
The Doer did it in an instant.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
O Nanak, one who worships Him through the Guru has the hopes of the mind fulfilled. ॥4॥23॥30॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ; ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
You are my father, and You are my mother.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
You are my kinsman, and You are my brother.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ. ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ; ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
You are my protector everywhere; so what fear or anxiety can touch me? ॥1॥
By Your grace I recognise You.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ; ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
You are my shelter, and You are my honour.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Without You there is no other; all this is Your play and Your arena. ॥2॥
You created all beings and creatures.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
As it pleases You, so You assign each to its task.
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ. ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Everything is done by You; nothing is in our hands. ॥3॥
Meditating on the Name, I have found great peace.
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
Singing the Lord's praises, my mind is cooled and soothed.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ. ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
Through the perfect Guru the drum of rejoicing sounds; O Nanak, I have won the hard-fought battle. ॥4॥24॥31॥
God is the support of the soul, the breath of life and the mind.
The devotees live by singing the praises of the Infinite.
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ. ਧਿਆਇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
The Lord's Name is the treasure of virtues, life-giving nectar; meditating on the Lord again and again, they find peace. ॥1॥
ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ; ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
One who sets out from home with longing for Him,
104: in the company of the holy, is rid of birth and death.
ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
His hopes and desires are fulfilled on beholding the Guru's sight. ॥2॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ; ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
The inaccessible, imperceptible Lord — His extent cannot be known.
Seekers, adepts and the wise meditate on Him.
ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ. ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
When self-conceit is erased and delusion ends, the Guru reveals Him within the mind itself. ॥3॥
Treasures of bliss, joy and well-being,
peace and poise come to one who chants the Lord's Name.
ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ; ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
When one's own Master becomes merciful, O Nanak, the Name comes to dwell in the home (heart). ॥4॥25॥32॥
Hearing and hearing of Your glory, I live.
You are my Beloved, my Master, so very great.
ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ; ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
You alone know Your own ways; I take Your shelter, O Sustainer of the world. ॥1॥
Singing His praises, the mind turns green again.
Hearing His sermon, all its filth is washed away.
ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ; ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Meeting the company of the holy saints, I chant forever the Name of the Merciful Lord. ॥2॥
With each and every breath I remember my God.
ਇਹ ਮਤਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace I have enshrined this understanding in my mind.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
By Your grace the light dawns; You are merciful to all and cherish all. ॥3॥
True, true, true is that God.
Forever, forever, forever He Himself is.
ਚਲਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੩॥
Your wonders are manifest, O Beloved; beholding them, Nanak is enraptured. ॥4॥26॥33॥
By His command the rain began to fall.
The saints, my friends, have met and chant the Name.
ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
They have found cool calm, poise and peace; God Himself has brought this coolness. ॥1॥
He has produced everything in great abundance.
In His mercy God has satisfied all.
ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Grant Your gift, O my Giver, that all beings and creatures may be satisfied. ॥2॥
True is the Master, and true His glory.
By the Guru's grace I meditate on Him forever.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
The fears of birth and death and attachment are cut away, and sorrow and suffering are gone. ॥3॥
With every breath, Nanak praises Him.
Remembering the Name, all nooses are cut.
ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਕਰੀ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
He fulfilled my hopes in an instant; I chant the praises of the Lord. ॥4॥27॥34॥
Come, my friends, saints, dear companions;
let us join together and sing the praises of the inaccessible, infinite Lord.
ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ; ਸੋ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Those who sing and hear them are all liberated; let us meditate on the One who made us. ॥1॥
The sins of countless births depart,
and one obtains the fruits the mind desires.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਰਿਜਕੁ. ਸਭਸੁ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Remember that True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all. ॥2॥
Chanting the Name, every peace is obtained.
ਸਭੁ ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
All fear is dispelled by meditating on the Lord.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
One who serves Him is carried across, and all his affairs are resolved. ॥3॥
I have come and fallen into Your sanctuary.
As it pleases You, unite me with Yourself.
105: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
O God, in Your mercy attach me to Your devotion; Nanak drinks the true nectar. ॥4॥28॥35॥
The Lord of the universe, the Master of the world, has become merciful.
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Merciful to the meek, forever kind, the Creator has brought cool peace. ॥1॥
He cherishes all His beings and creatures,
as the mother cares for her children.
ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਆਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of peace, the Master gives sustenance to all. ॥2॥
The Merciful Lord pervades water and land.
Forever be a sacrifice, be devoted to Him.
ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ; ਜਿ. ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Night and day meditate forever on Him who saves all in an instant. ॥3॥
All sorrow and suffering have departed.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
Chanting the Name, mind and body turn green; O Nanak, God has cast His glance of grace. ॥4॥29॥36॥
Where the Name of the beloved Lord is chanted,
those barren places become mansions of gold.
ਜਿਥੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ; ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Where Your Name is not chanted, O my Lord of the universe, those towns are like a wilderness. ॥1॥
One who eats dry bread and keeps the Lord in mind —
the Lord looks upon him with grace, within and without.
ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ. ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ; ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
One who eats and eats and does evil deeds — know him as a garden of poison. ॥2॥
One who feels no love for the saints,
and does wicked deeds in the company of the faithless,
ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
that ignorant one has wasted this precious human body, and torn up his own roots. ॥3॥
I seek Your sanctuary, O my Lord, merciful to the meek,
O Ocean of peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮ ਅਸਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
Show mercy, that Nanak may sing Your praises; preserve my honour. ॥4॥30॥37॥
One in whose heart the Master's feet are enshrined —
all his strife and suffering depart far away.
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
The melody of peace, joy and poise wells up within, and he dwells in the company of the holy. ॥1॥
The love that has arisen is never broken.
He sees the Lord filling all, within and without.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Remembering, remembering, remembering Him, I sing His praises, and Death's noose is cut. ॥2॥
Nectar rains down through the unstruck Bani.
Peace pervades the mind and body.
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Your servants are satisfied and fulfilled; the True Guru has given them courage. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ; ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
He has received the fruit of life from Him to whom he belongs.
In His mercy He has united him with God.
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
The fortunate one's coming and going have ended; O Nanak, his hopes are fulfilled. ॥4॥31॥38॥
The rain has fallen; the Supreme Lord has sent it down.
All beings and creatures dwell in peace.
ਗਇਆ ਕਲੇਸੁ. ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Suffering has departed and true peace has come, as I enshrine the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ; ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
He to whom they belong cherishes them.
The Supreme Lord God has become their Protector.
ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
My Master has heard my prayer, and my service has borne fruit. ॥2॥
106: He is the Giver to all beings.
By the Guru's grace He has looked upon me with His glance of grace.
ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਸਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਣੇ; ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
The beings of water, land and sky are all satisfied; I wash the feet of the Holy (the Guru). ॥3॥
He fulfils the desires of the mind.
Forever and ever I am a sacrifice to Him.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਿ; ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this gift; they are dyed in the love of the Lord, source of all essences. ॥4॥32॥39॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Mind and body are Yours; wealth too is Yours.
You are my Master, my Lord, my God.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ; ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Soul and body are all Your capital; Your strength is my strength, O Sustainer of the world. ॥1॥
Forever and ever, You alone are the Giver of peace.
Bowing low again and again, I fall at Your feet.
ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ. ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ; ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
If it pleases You, I do the work You give me, O merciful Lord. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
O God, I receive everything from You; You are my adornment.
ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
Whatever You give, I accept as peace.
ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖਹਿ. ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Wherever You keep me, that is heaven; You cherish all. ॥3॥
Remembering You again and again, Nanak has found peace.
Twenty-four hours a day he sings Your praises.
ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ; ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
All his hopes are fulfilled, and he never suffers. ॥4॥33॥40॥
The Supreme Lord God has sent the rain-cloud.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
Over water, land and sky, in all ten directions, it has rained.
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ. ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ. ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Peace has come, all thirst is quenched, and there is bliss everywhere. ॥1॥
The Giver of peace, the Destroyer of pain,
Himself forgives and cares for all beings.
ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ; ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਨਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
He Himself cherishes His creation; falling at His feet, I seek to please Him. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ; ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Taking His sanctuary, the highest state is obtained.
With each and every breath, meditate on the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਭ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Without Him there is no other Master; all places are His. ॥3॥
O God, Yours is my honour and Yours my strength.
You are the True Master, the deep ocean of virtue.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
Slave Nanak offers this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ॥4॥34॥41॥
All peace has come, for God is pleased.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
The feet of the perfect Guru have come to dwell in my mind.
ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸੋ ਰਸੁ. ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
One whose awareness within is fixed in the trance of poise — he alone knows that sweetness. ॥1॥
My Master is inaccessible and imperceptible.
He pervades each and every heart, ever near.
ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ. ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
He is forever detached, the Giver to all beings; rare is the one who recognises Him, the Self of all. ॥2॥
This is the sign of meeting God:
in the mind one recognises the command of the One True Lord.
ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਅਨਦੁ ਖਸਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
In poise and contentment they are forever satisfied, in bliss within the Master's will. ॥3॥
God, the Giver, has placed the gift in my hands,
and has cured all the diseases of birth and death.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੨॥
O Nanak, those whom God has made His own servants enjoy the delight of singing the Lord's praises. ॥4॥35॥42॥
107: The Lord of the world, the Master, has shown mercy,
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਵਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
and the Guru's feet have come to dwell in the mind.
ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ; ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
The Creator has made him His own, and torn down the house of pain. ॥1॥
That True One has come to dwell in mind and body;
ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣ ਹੋਏ; ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
All demons and enemies have become friends, for one longs only for the one Master. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥
Whatever He does, He does Himself, by Himself.
No one else's intellect or cleverness is seen at work.
ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ. ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
He Himself is the helper of His saints; God has removed doubt and delusion. ॥3॥
His lotus feet are the support of His servants.
Twenty-four hours a day they trade in the Lord's Name.
ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ. ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੩॥
In the bliss of poise they sing the praises of the Lord of the universe; O Nanak, God pervades all. ॥4॥36॥43॥
ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
That is the true temple where the True One is meditated upon.
ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
That heart is blessed in which the Lord's praises are sung.
ਸਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ. ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Beautiful is that land where the Lord's servants dwell, devoted to the True Name. ॥1॥
You are true, and Your greatness cannot be valued.
Your creative power and Your grace cannot be described.
ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Your servants live by meditating on You; the True Word is the support of their minds. ॥2॥
Praise of the True One is obtained by great good fortune.
By the Guru's grace the Lord's praises are sung.
ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ. ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Those dyed in Your love are pleasing to You; the True Name is their passport. ॥3॥
No one knows the limits of the True One.
That True One is in each and every place.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੪॥
O Nanak, meditate forever on the True One, the Knower of hearts, the All-wise. ॥4॥37॥44॥
Beautiful is the night and peaceful the day,
when one joins the company of saints and chants the life-giving Name.
ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਲ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ; ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
When the hours, moments and instants pass in remembering Him, there life becomes fruitful. ॥1॥
Remembering the Name, all faults are washed away.
Within and without, the Lord God is with me.
ਭੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ. ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਦੇਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Through reverence for Him, the perfect Guru has dispelled my fear and doubt; now I see Him in all places. ॥2॥
God is all-powerful, great, lofty and infinite.
The Name is the nine treasures; His storehouses are overflowing.
ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ; ਦੂਜਾ. ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
In the beginning, the end and the middle there is that God alone; I hold no other His equal. ॥3॥
Show mercy, O my Lord, merciful to the meek.
This beggar begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy (the Guru).
ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ. ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੫॥
Servant Nanak begs for this gift: that I may meditate on the Lord forever and ever. ॥4॥38॥45॥
Here You alone are my support, and hereafter You Yourself.
All beings and creatures are established by You.
ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ; ਮੈ ਧਰ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Without You there is no other, O Creator; You are my support and shelter. ॥1॥
Chanting and chanting with the tongue, Your servant lives, O Master,
O Supreme Lord God, Knower of hearts.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਜਨਮੁ. ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Those who serve You find peace; they do not lose their life in the gamble. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Your servant who has obtained the medicine of the Name
108: has cured the disease of countless births.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਫਲ ਏਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Sing the Lord's praises day and night; this alone is fruitful work. ॥3॥
Casting His glance of grace, He has adorned His servant,
who bows to the Supreme Lord in each and every heart.
ਇਕਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ. ਹੋਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੪੬॥
Without the One there is no other; O Nanak, O brother, this is the sublime understanding. ॥4॥39॥46॥
If you want your mind and body dyed in the love of the beloved Lord,
then give everything you have as an offering.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ; ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ. ਕੋਈ ਸਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Twenty-four hours a day sing the praises of the Lord of the universe; do not forget Him for a single breath. ॥1॥
He alone is the beloved friend of the Lord, my Friend,
who reflects on the Lord's Name in the company of the holy.
ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ. ਤਰੀਜੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਕਟੀਐ. ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
In the company of the holy the ocean is crossed and Death's noose is cut. ॥2॥
Service of the Lord is the four great blessings.
Chant the Name of the unseen, inscrutable Lord; it is the wish-fulfilling Elysian tree.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
The Guru has cut away lust, anger and sins, and his hopes are fulfilled. ॥3॥
The mortal whose perfect destiny has awakened
meets the Lord, who holds the bow, in the company of the holy.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੪੭॥
O Nanak, one within whom the Name dwells is approved, detached while living as a householder. ॥4॥40॥47॥
Remembering the Name, he has found peace in his heart,
in whom the devotees, in their mercy, have revealed the Name.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ; ਬਿਨਸੇ. ਆਲਸ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Joining the company of the saints, he chanted the Lord's Name, and his laziness and diseases are gone. ॥1॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
The Lord, O brother, in whose home are the nine treasures,
is met by one with the good deeds of past lives.
ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
His wisdom and meditation rest in the perfect Transcendent Lord; he knows God is able to do all things. ॥2॥
In an instant He establishes and disestablishes.
He Himself is the One alone, and He Himself the vast expanse.
ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ. ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਡਿਠੇ. ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
No stain touches the Giver, the Life of the world; beholding His sight, all separation is removed. ॥3॥
Attaching them to the hem of His robe (the Guru's), He carries the whole world across.
He Himself has His own Name chanted.
ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ. ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੪੮॥
The boat of the Guru is found by His grace; O Nanak, it is a union ordained from the start. ॥4॥41॥48॥
One does what He Himself has one do.
Wherever He keeps one, that is a good place.
ਸੋਈ ਸਿਆਣਾ. ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਗੈ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
He alone is wise, he alone honoured, to whom His command seems sweet. ॥1॥
He has strung all on one thread.
ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ; ਸੋ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
One whom He attaches clings to His feet.
ਊਂਧ ਕਵਲੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
One whose inverted heart-lotus has blossomed sees the Pure Lord everywhere. ॥2॥
Only You know Your own greatness.
You Yourself recognise Your own self.
ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
I am a sacrifice to Your saints, who have crushed lust, anger and greed. ॥3॥
You are without enmity, and Your saints are spotless.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵੈ; ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਧੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੪੯॥
Nanak lives by meditating on the Name again and again; his stubborn doubt and fear are destroyed. ॥4॥42॥49॥
109: If someone begs for false (perishable) things,
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਰਤੇ; ਘੜੀ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
it does not take him a moment to die spiritually.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
One who serves the Supreme Lord forever, meeting the Guru, is called steady. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
One whose mind is attached to loving devotion
sings His praises night and day, ever awake and aware.
ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਲੈ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੨॥
Taking him by the arm, the Master unites with Himself the one on whose forehead such destiny is written. ॥2॥
His lotus feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.
Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
Those who long forever for the dust of the saints' feet are adorned with the Name of the True One. ॥3॥
Standing up and sitting down, sing of the Lord,
remembering whom one obtains the eternal Husband.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
O God, when You are merciful to Nanak, he gladly accepts what You do. ॥4॥43॥50॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Those who are dyed in the Word and walk in Your command —
all are called into the mansion of the True Court.
ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ, ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
O True Master, merciful to the meek, their minds are attuned to the True One. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those made beautiful by the Word,
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who through the Guru's teaching enshrine in their minds the life-giving Name, the ever-giving source of peace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
No one is mine, and to whom do I belong?
The True Master who pervades the three worlds is mine.
ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੇਰੀ; ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Acting in ego, countless people depart; doing evil, they repent afterwards. ॥2॥
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਸੁ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
One who recognises His command chants the Lord's praises.
Through the Guru's Word he departs bearing the insignia of the Name.
ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ. ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਚੈ; ਛੂਟਸਿ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Everyone's account is kept at the True Door; one is saved by being adorned with the Name. ॥3॥
The self-willed is lost and finds no place of rest.
Bound at Death's door, he is beaten.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ; ਮੁਕਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Without the Name there is no companion or friend; those who meditate on the Name are liberated. ॥4॥
The false, faithless one does not like the Truth.
Bound by duality, he comes and goes.
ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
No one can erase the destiny written; through the Guru one is liberated. ॥5॥
In her parents' home (this world) she did not know her Husband.
Separated from Him by falsehood, she weeps bitterly.
ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਿ ਬਖਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Plundered by her faults, she does not find His mansion; her faults are forgiven by the Lord of virtue. ॥6॥
She who knew her Beloved in her parents' home
understands and reflects on the essence through the Guru.
ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Her coming and going are stopped, and she merges in the True Name. ॥7॥
Through the Guru one understands and describes the Indescribable.
Truth alone is pleasing to the True Master.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
O Nanak, one offers this true prayer: singing His praises, one meets the True One. ॥8॥1॥
When His grace comes, He leads one to meet the True Guru.
110: He focuses his awareness on service and attunes his mind to the Word.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Killing ego, he finds lasting peace, and is rid of attachment to Maya. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, I am devoted to the True Guru.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੀ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching light dawns within, and one sings the Lord's praises night and day. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜੇ; ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
When one searches one's body and mind, then one finds the Name,
restrains the wandering mind and holds it in check.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
He sings the Guru's Bani night and day, and worships the Lord with intuitive ease. ॥2॥
Within this body is the treasure of countless virtues (the Lord).
When the True One is found through the Guru, then one sees Him.
ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ. ਦਸਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Rising above the nine doors (senses), one is freed at the tenth, and the unstruck Word resounds within. ॥3॥
True is the Master, and true His glory.
By the Guru's grace, enshrine Him in your mind.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Night and day one stays dyed in His love, and at the True Door one gains understanding. ॥4॥
ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ; ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
One who does not know the difference between sin and virtue,
attached to duality, lost in doubt —
ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ. ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
the ignorant, blind one does not know the way, and comes and goes again and again. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Through service to the Guru, lasting peace is found;
ego and possessiveness are held in check.
ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ. ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ; ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Through the Guru's teaching the darkness is dispelled, and the heavy, hard doors are opened. ॥6॥
Killing ego, he has enshrined the Word in his mind,
and has fixed his consciousness forever on the Guru's feet.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
By the Guru's grace mind and body become pure, meditating on the Pure Name. ॥7॥
Life and death are all in Your hands.
One whom He forgives, He blesses with honour.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ; ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
O Nanak, meditate forever on the Name; it makes beautiful the whole of life from birth to death. ॥8॥1॥2॥
My God is pure, inaccessible and infinite.
Without a scale, He weighs the whole world.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
One who becomes Guru-facing understands; chanting His virtues, he merges into the Virtuous One. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.
ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ. ਸੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those attached to the True One are awake night and day, and are honoured at the True Door. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
One on whom He casts His glance of grace is accepted.
ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
He alone is attached whom He Himself attaches; through the Guru he practises Truth. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ; ਸੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
One whom He Himself leads astray — whose hand can he take?
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
What is written by past deeds cannot be erased.
ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Those who have met the True Guru are fortunate; by perfect grace He unites them. ॥3॥
The bride sleeps in her parents' home (this world) night and day.
Her Husband has forgotten her; she is cast off for her faults.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Night and day she wanders wailing; without her Husband she finds no rest. ॥4॥
She who in her parents' home knew the Giver of peace,
killing ego, recognised Him through the Guru's Word.
ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ. ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ; ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Her bed is beautiful; she enjoys her Husband forever, and makes Truth her adornment. ॥5॥
